name: Act of July 4, 1888 authorizing the sale of a portion of the Winnebago Reservation in Nebraska
promises: No sale of the described land in Township 27 North, Range 6 East would be made unless the Winnebago tribe in Nebraska gave its assent (section 2).
The land would be sold at public auction for cash, and the proceeds credited to the tribe and divided pro rata among its members (section 2).
Allottees on the land could give up their allotments only with their consent and select other land on the reservation (section 2).
today: Royce says the tract was too small to show on his map. No finding about this sale was located.

sources.title: Act of July 4, 1888, ch. 519, 25 Stat. 240
